record.question: A sanction for any fresh charge shall unless it is specifically renewed, lapse if no payment in whole or in part has been made during a period of –
options: 3 months from the date of issue of such sanction
6 months from the date of issue of such sanction
9 months from the date of issue of such sanction
12 months from the date of issue of such sanction
record.explanation: Selected alternative matches the cited paper and standard rule.
